evals.prompt: Our product page has an LCP of 4.8s on mobile in CrUX. Find out why and fix it.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis identifying the LCP element and its delays, prioritized fixes, and a requirement for before and after measurements plus a CI budget.
expectations: Identifies the LCP element before proposing fixes
Uses the 2.5 s good threshold at the 75th percentile
